# Clavis 3.8.0

## 🔧 Under the hood

- Groundwork for Clavis on Android: the encryption engine has been separated from the Windows/Linux app so the same, tested code can run on phones.
- Nothing changes in how you use Clavis. Your encrypted files, vaults, recovery keys, shared files and backups open exactly as before — this release is checked against files made by every earlier version of Clavis.

## Install / upgrade

- **Windows, already installed:** the app updates itself (Settings → Updates → Check now).
- **Linux:** install the new `.deb` from https://clavisenc.com/download.html.

Your vaults and settings are kept.
